deliverables.contents: Writing mechanics per source channel/study across 19 corpus sections plus a convergent-core synthesis and an evidence map: line construction, dialogue moves/twining, hook structure, payoff/hanger structure, caption and title grammar, verbatim specimens exactly as quoted in the studies, and explicit 'no line-level evidence' records where a study has none (clipcraft7, clone census, Cantina clones, roach network, btc_shifty, Dr. Dreams, surreailist, niceaunties, kurupuri0).

Fourteen evidenced themes (rank misread, number-as-stake, household betrayal, hidden identity/audience secret, hunger and being eaten, captivity/occupation, poverty vs mansion, humiliation settled item by item, belonging tested, plain want in an insane world, status as public sport, mother/child/abandonment, transformation, the mundane elsewhere), each tied to named studies, then mapped onto the msg-583 base lore: already ours (7 mappings), available to adopt (7), fights the lore (6, including the corpus's own warning against the wrong-species-baby guilt engine).

Thirteen amendments (A-1..A-13), each with the change in one sentence, the case-study evidence, the exact landing spot (DIALOGUE_METHOD.md pass / template field / gate), and the writers-room application. A-13 is FLAGGED as arguing a change to ratified F-26's application (line band as ceiling, not target); F-25 caps untouched. Includes a checked-and-held section (Stranger Test, Camp B, Container Law, ear-test, Gate (f), end-state pin, want-announcement ban all stand, with the field evidence that supports them) and a not-amended section for absent evidence. No target document was edited; the parent lands these.

directive: Telegram msg 677 (2026-11-18 ~20:55 EST): use the case studies of the other channels to find the writings and themes so we can make our writing more based
gaps: clipcraft7 study contains no line-level dialogue examples (empty captions by design, workflow undisclosed) — flagged in WRITINGS S3/S20 and AMENDMENTS 'Not amended'.

Clone census and Cantina clones report contain no verbatim dialogue; roach network node 3 post text unreachable; overcookmyself reproduces no full dialogue lines; surreailist/niceaunties/kurupuri0/btc_shifty/Dr. Dreams are non-dialogue forms by design.
No published corpus study measures dialogue redundancy quantitatively; 'fact stated at least twice' remains a specimen observation (fruit-soap study 2's own stated gap).
summary: Mined the banked channel case studies (fruit-soap/brainrot studies, Clippie, the 16-factory clone census, clipcraft7, both Cantina studies and the clones report, king/pauper, Dookie, Gossip Goblin's style guide and report, the roach network map and node studies, overcookmyself, btc_shifty, Dr. Dreams, surreailist, niceaunties, kurupuri0, talking-story creators) for their writing mechanics and themes, using four parallel mining agents whose findings were cross-checked against DIALOGUE_METHOD.md and THE_STANDARD.md read directly. The field's writing converges on: one line = one scene = one move, conflict in line 1, four line-types only, lines twined to the line before, facts spent twice in different words, proof objects instead of reported conflict, one value change per episode paid forward by a hanger with interest, speech rules before lines, and payload word last. The themes converge on rank misread, a worn number running down, household betrayal, captivity that feeds on the captive, and a plain petty want inside an insane filing system — all five already present in occupation form in the base lore. Thirteen evidence-tied amendments are filed for the parent to land; the standing gates (Stranger Test, F-25, Container Law, ear-test, Gate (f), Camp B, end-state pin) were checked against the evidence and held. The largest gap is structural: clipcraft7, the genre's biggest channel, has no recoverable line-level dialogue in the banked record, so its amendments are packaging-only by design.
